text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the day she gave up on traveling to the US, Cesario
carried out her training in quiet detachment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It felt so unnatural that brushing it off as just 'moving on quickly' seemed too hasty an assumption.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back when her post-debut rotation had to be completely wiped
due to an injury, she was terribly downcast.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her reaction is clearly different from back then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I recall how she looked when we talked about giving up on the overseas campaign.
A long silence—followed only by words concerning what to do moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looked as though she had detached her emotions...
as if she were forcibly suppressing them.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“—So, what did you want to discuss?
Trainer.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she spoke in her calm, matter-of-fact way,
I asked if there was anything she wanted to say
about giving up on taking on overseas challenges.
choice_data_list: Whether it's how you really feel or whatever, I don't mind.
Whether it's how you really feel or whatever, just tell me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: True feelings—?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: As I mentioned the other day, we should expedite our preparations for the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...You're saying that's not what you truly feel?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We can't just keep lamenting
over what has already passed.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We take the best course on our chosen path.
I've simply made a logical decision.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She declared it flatly.
There didn't seem to be any sign she was hiding something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Which means—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her defense mechanisms may have kicked in,
temporarily blinding her to her own emotions—
that is a real possibility.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer?
Is that all you wanted to discuss?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...At the very least, confronting her emotions
recklessly right now is not a wise move."
choice_data_list: Yeah, sorry for taking up your time.
Yeah, sorry for taking up your time.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all.
There was actually one thing I wanted to consult you about as well.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I'd like to review the training regimen for the "Summer Training Camp" once more...――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The countermeasure depends on the severity.
Some things naturally heal over time,
while others require proper intervention.
choice_data_list: (If I want to be in perfect condition, I should rest. But—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If we take racing away from her now,
it might lead to something even more irreversible."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"First, we wait for it to heal naturally.
If it reaches its limit, I'll recommend treatment."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With my mind made up, I waited for the time to come.
Soon, the days grew longer, and the cicadas' hum swelled—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll head down to the beach first.
I'll finish warming up by the time
you're ready, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Let us overcome this summer together, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the "Summer Training Camp" began.
